notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes (update V0.4.1)
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Dear Calamity Administrator[/b][/h1]

It's our pleasure to bring you this update. [u]This update needs to delete the ongoing Calamity Clearing and will return the rewards corresponding to the progress settlement.[/u]

Please check the full update information below :

[h1][b]Add and adjustment[/b][/h1]

·Valkyries can be tier-up now. In the game, administrators can get the item "Soul Core", which can upgrade Valkyries. One tier up, Valkyries will be much more powerful and each valkyrie can tier up twice. Some Valkyries even may change after second-tier up.
When administrators contain Soul Core, consumables will have an effective display.
·Added a voice system to Valkyrie, each Valkyrie will have a Japanese voice sound. In the game, you will have a chance to interact with them.
·Added "Astra Casino" and "Lottery Ticket". If administrators are not satisfied with dropping, you can use "Lottery Ticket" and make a better life. The higher Lucky, the higher the chance of getting a good item.
·Added Workshop-Adventure, administrators can create their own adventure stories and add them to the game.
·Added Workshop-Soul Gear and Workshop-Emblem.
·Added some Ultra Command, some old Ultra Command will move into Regular Command.
·Added function that reset saves will refund progress reward, we are trying to reduce the administrators' inconvenience that upgrade system causes.
·Added a free DLC, containing part of the game resource.
·Added the opening scene, which will connect to the trial. Administrators will experience it if you don't finish the trial.
·Added new Soul Gear and Emblem.

[h1][b]Optimization[/b][/h1]
·Optimized the second confirm window, and put all buttons into a specific place.
·We have to make adjustments to the system in order to fit the new gameplay.


[h1][b]Fix[/b][/h1]
·Fixed Workshop known problem.
·Fixed Action preview known problem.

We really appreciate every player who reports they are facing a bug or crushing issue. If you have to meet any bugs, please contact us in-game 'Report Problem', via steam, discord.
